decisions.reason: Vertical installation does not necessarily alter the existing right-angle JST orientation or battery-cable accessibility constraint; both remain valid unchanged.
The mechanical installation-orientation change does not alter electrical battery protection, controller, or cutoff-voltage requirements.
The board's vertical fit does not change the NTC terminal, connector, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The power-board installation orientation does not affect the main-board SK6812 charge-status interface or its GPIO assignment.
The source decision concerns mechanical fit and does not alter the selected LED family or data GPIO.
Vertical board installation does not change the boost converter, enable control, default state, powered loads, or usage pattern.
The mechanical orientation change does not alter I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up board location.
